notes: High-level: replacing in-house retrieval + Lambda reranker to improve top-5 precision while cutting per-query infra cost
They operate a 12M-document knowledge index (tickets + KB + community posts). Avg doc size ~3KB, target index growth ~2M/year.
Primary goal: ticket deflection — automated answer suggestions + surfacing existing KB articles. Secondary: agent assist (summaries).
Latency constraints: end-to-end retrieval + rerank must meet p95 < 200ms for UA (North America) interactive paths; soft p99 < 350ms.
Throughput during peak: 5k qps for deflection checks (lightweight), 600 qps for full rerank + generation. Cost sensitivity: target <$0.025/query average at scale.
Model preferences: embeddings dim 1536 (open model), candidate retrieval via approximate NN then lightweight learned reranker (prefer CPU-friendly scoring + GPU fallback for heavy rerank).
Routing/fallback needs: prefer single-hop retrieval on Dedicated; fallback to smaller embedding index if Dedicated capacity constrained. Must support A/B reranker rollouts.
Security: must support SSO for Console, VPC peering for data paths, KMS integration and audit logs forwarded to customer SIEM.
Quote from Head of Product: "If we can get top-5 accuracy up 12-15% and keep p95 under 200ms, this is a material win for ops."
Internal note: tech team very familiar with Elastic + custom FAISS pipelines; skeptical about vendor lock and vector DB portability.
Requested artifacts: POC load script, sample latency profile (p50/p95/p99), transparent cost breakdown per token + per vector lookup.
top_priorities: 1) Achieve p95 retrieval+rerank <200ms for NA region
2) Demonstrate top-5 precision improvement vs current reranker by >=12%
3) Clear cost model: <$0.025 avg per full query at 12M index scale
4) VPC-based architecture and SOC2 + KMS compliance

Reranker must be configurable for feature inputs (BM25 score, vector distance, recency signal, ticket metadata)
Fast path: CPU-only learned reranker for low-latency; heavy path: GPU-ranked model for complex queries
Support A/B testing and automated rollback based on production metrics
